content: .{@-परार्थता@} ‘an unaccepted second sense’, one of the faults of a word (शब्ददोष); अमतः प्रकृतविरुद्धः परार्थो यत्र; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in राममन्मथशरेण ताडिता <ab>&c.</ab> (<ls>R. 11. 20</ls>) the second sense suggestive of शृङ्गाररस is opposed to the proper {%rasa%} of the passage which is either वीर or बीभत्स; <ls>K. P. 7</ls>.
